name: Figurine of Wondrous Power, Silver Raven

text.plain: A Figurine of Wondrous Power is a pocket-sized statuette that becomes its specified living creature when thrown to the ground with a Magic action. This silver statuette of a raven can become a Raven for up to 12 hours. Once it has been used, it can't be used again until 2 days have passed. While in raven form, the figurine grants you the ability to cast Animal Messenger on it.
